title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Months of Recovery for Veterans Pension Recipients of Limited Assets
content:
In measuring a compromise offer on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**, the months over which VA's recovery is measured depend on the debtor's **Veterans Pension** award and assets.

**Rule.** A debtor with a running Veterans Pension award at the Housebound or Aid and Attendance rate whose recorded net worth is below the asset limit of 25000.00 USD is measured over the care-level months of 36 months. A debtor with a running Veterans Pension award at the basic rate whose net worth is below that limit is measured over the basic-pension months of 48 months. Other debtors are outside this rule.

| Running Veterans Pension award | Net worth below 25,000.00 USD | Months of recovery |
|---|---|---|
| Housebound or Aid and Attendance (No Dependents or One Dependent) | Yes | 36 |
| Basic Rate (No Dependents or One Dependent) | Yes | 48 |
| Any | No | Not set by this rule |
| No running award | — | Not set by this rule |

The rate category and the net worth are read from the debtor's Veterans Pension award.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** A Housebound pensioner with net worth 24,999.99 USD: 36 months. The same with exactly 25,000.00 USD: not set by this rule. A Basic Rate pensioner with net worth 8,000.00 USD: 48 months.
